description.p: Flow is a privacy-first desktop client for YouTube and YouTube Music, and the desktop companion to Flow for Android. It needs no account and contains no ads, analytics or telemetry. History, playlists, settings and recommendations stay on your computer.

ul.li: Native video playback with quality and codec choice, chapters, subtitles, playback speed, queues and a mini player
YouTube Music with search, artists, albums, playlists and synced lyrics
A Shorts feed, channel pages, comments and live chat
Local subscriptions, playlists, Watch Later, likes and history
Recommendations ranked on your device by FlowNeuro, with a Control Center to inspect and reset what it learned
SponsorBlock, DeArrow and Return YouTube Dislike
Sync with Flow for Android over your local network
Imports from Google Takeout, NewPipe, LibreTube, FreeTube and OPML

description.p: Flow is under active development. Features and storage formats may change before the first stable release.

A bug-fix release built on beta-tester feedback: Linux startup and packaging, livestreams, the Home feed, the player, subscriptions, search, backups and downloads, plus faster starts for videos, Shorts and music.
